h1: Andreas Ulbrich – a family of smiths since 1934
lead: Forging came into the Ulbrich family in 1934 with Andreas’ grandfather. Today Andreas Ulbrich carries the craft on in the third generation – in his own workshop, Messermanufaktur Ulbrich, in Stein am Kocher near Heilbronn.

items.x: With him, smithing came into the family, and he shaped Andreas’ approach to forging.
The second generation carried the craft on.
After his workshop in Aalen, Andreas opened Messermanufaktur Ulbrich in Stein am Kocher on 1 March 2024 – with forging courses and handmade knives.
“Being able to forge is a privilege for me.” – Andreas Ulbrich, quoted in Schwäbische Post, 12 April 2021 (translated from German).

Andreas Ulbrich is a bladesmith and a member of the Chamber of Crafts Heilbronn-Franken. In the workshop he makes damascus knives, kitchen, hunting and folding knives, custom pieces and the numbered Edition 100 – and teaches people to forge their own knife.
Messermanufaktur Ulbrich, Wannenstraße 33, 74196 Neuenstadt am Kocher (Stein am Kocher), Germany. You can collect your knife here by appointment and pay in cash or by card.

faq.a: In Stein am Kocher, part of Neuenstadt am Kocher, in the district of Heilbronn, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.

faq.q: How long has the family been forging?
faq.a: Since 1934. Andreas Ulbrich is the third generation.
